claim_type: structural dichotomy with certified germ models
limitations: Germ-level dichotomy only; both examples have vanishing first jet and lie outside the nondegenerate compact hypothesis. No compact one-point model or global non-unimodularity theorem is claimed.
provenance: Previously published finding; independent mathematical reassessment completed and accepted.
record_title: Sharp local (non-)unimodularity dichotomy at isolated rank-zero points in dimension 4
